hana.docs: Quick announcement for the SDK/docs teams: we're changing the default retry behavior for the generation endpoints and updating the docs. This is a behavioral change that can affect some clients.

High level: default retry policy moves from 3 fixed retries with exponential backoff to a smarter `adaptive` strategy that considers idempotency and quota signals. We'll flip the hosted API default and update SDKs to default to `adaptive` in 60 days.

Why: lots of customers hit cost/latency surprises when transient server errors triggered repeated full-model runs. Adaptive retries reduce unnecessary retries for non-idempotent calls and back off more aggressively when quota throttling is detected. Improves p99 latency under noisy neighbors.

Impacts and guarantees:
- Existing callers with no explicit `retry_policy` will see the new default after the switch.
- SDKs will preserve explicit `retry_policy` values; if you set `retry_policy: 'fixed'` nothing changes.
- For users who rely on exact retry counts for billing predictions, we will provide a server-side opt-out header for 60 days.
- No change to embeddings endpoints.

kevin.sdk: Implementation notes: JS/Python/Rust SDKs will ship minor patches that log a deprecation/info line when no policy is set, showing the upcoming default and how to opt out. Example (py):

```py
# explicit, unaffected
client.generate(..., retry_policy='fixed', retry_count=3)

# no policy -> will use adaptive after rollout
client.generate(...)
```

We'll include a compatibility flag: `SDK_DEFAULT_RETRY=legacy` env var in CI for internal infra during migration testing.

priya.eng: On the runtime side we'll add the adaptive policy in a feature-flagged release. Hosted API flip will be a coordinated rollout over 48h. We'll expose a response header `X-Redwood-Retry-Mode` so callers can detect which policy was applied.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: stage -> canary -> global during the week of Apr 20. Docs rebuild scheduled post-rollout.

marco.support: Need a short blurb for support docs and a canned reply for customers asking about increased retries or billing differences. I'll draft and link it to the migration page.

vera.product: Can we include a short non-technical summary for account teams explaining why this improves reliability and cost? Sales and AMs will need one-pager.

hana.docs: Yes  I'll make three artifacts: 1) migration guide with examples, 2) one-pager for AMs, 3) changelog entry. Internal link placeholders: https://redwood.internal/migrations/retry-defaults and https://redwood.internal/changelog/retry-defaults.

kevin.sdk: Dev checklist for SDKs: ship patches that preserve explicit policies, add opt-out env var, add deprecation/info warning, update examples to show explicit `retry_policy` usage.

priya.eng: Dedicated/Private: we'll publish a runtime patch and a toggle in the control plane so customers can pin `legacy` policy for a maintenance window. We'll also provide the header so they can validate behavior in their staging.

hana.docs: Action items:
- [x] Draft migration guide and AM one-pager (hana)
- [ ] SDK patches: accept explicit policy unchanged + info warning (kevin)
- [ ] Runtime feature-flagged rollout & response header (priya)
- [ ] Support canned replies and billing FAQ (marco)
- [ ] AM-facing one-pager review (vera)

If you own an unchecked item, drop a :thumbsup: and post the PR/issue link here. We'll review in the next docs sync. Thanks!
